item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: New native macOS design (Overview, 4-stage New Release, History, Products). Readme & Assets Update without a new version, Restore Older Version, Bump Version, build command per product, optional GitHub release per product, PHP lint and Plugin Check, deeper readme/asset/theme checks, Tested up to compared with the current WordPress, directory status after release, longer commit timeout. See CHANGELOG.md for details.
